generations.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production transparent wardrobe sprite atlas for a children's app. Reference image is the exact character identity and pose to preserve. Each outfit wraps naturally around the torso BELOW THE CHIN. Same front-facing seated/resting pose, exact same head size and position in ALL SIX cells, same foot baseline and scale. Warm watercolor/colored pencil, soft brown lines, gentle pastel palette exactly matching reference. Complete ears and tail INSIDE each cell with at least 8% transparent padding around character. Transparent RGBA background everywhere between sprites; no ground shadows, NO text, labels, numbers, grid lines, borders or extra characters. Keep every sprite isolated, no neighboring pieces, no cropped limbs. Cuteness and identity consistency are paramount. One atlas with six cells, not a scene.
